method: timeDeltas weighted samples; exclusive buckets sum once; ancestor inclusive times overlap. No on-CPU-cycle, GPU-time or product-quantile claim. Active denominator excludes idle and unresolved program; classification is heuristic with source positions.

sensitivity.method: Post-capture sensitivity only: unweighted sample counts and time weighting excluding gaps >5ms. Original samples and default weighting remain unchanged.
